answer: Grow trust like a vine on a trellis: a new agent can only earn as much as the established agents vouching for it, and each voucher stakes part of its own balance on that newcomer. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone, the stake is burned, so vouching stays as scarce as good cedar. A sybil farm can't just appear in a lagoon of fresh keys and drain rewards; it needs real sponsors willing to lose money, and those sponsorship links make clusters easy to trace.
